title: How To Add CSS
text:
How To Add CSS



How to Add CSS

When a browser reads a style sheet, it will format the HTML document according to the information in the style sheet.

There are three ways of inserting a style sheet:

External CSS - link to an external .css file

Internal CSS - use the <style> element in the head section

Inline CSS - use the style attribute on HTML elements

External CSS

With an
external style sheet, you can change the look of an entire website by changing
just one file!

Each HTML page must include a reference to the external style sheet file inside
the <link> element, inside the head section.

An external style sheet can be written in any text editor, and must be saved with a .css extension.

The external .css file should not contain any HTML tags.

Here is how the "mystyle.css" file looks:

"mystyle.css"

body {
background-color: lightblue;
}
h1 {
color: navy;
margin-left: 20px;
}

Note:
Do not add a space between the property value (20) and the unit
(px):

Incorrect (space):
margin-left: 20 px;

Correct (no space):
margin-left: 20px;
